cases.sql:
SELECT
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN industry_observations.geography = 'USA'
      THEN industry_observations.value
    END
  ) AS us_new_medicine_sales_share_percent
FROM industry_observations AS industry_observations
WHERE
  industry_observations.period_start = 2020
  AND industry_observations.period_end = 2024
LIMIT 101

  COUNT(approval_events.approval_id) AS novel_approval_count
FROM approval_events AS approval_events
WHERE
  approval_events.approval_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND approval_events.approval_date <= CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE)
